suites: wrangler dry-run for learning runtime preview
Subject Web App and Russian chunk-manifest verification

changes: Browser gate deterministic richness preload and slow-runner timeout hardening
Windows checkout audit status reporting correction

findings.summary: Activity Studio lesson/activity identity could follow stale E169 state instead of current E186 path.
findings.resolution: Made Activity Studio E186-aware and added durable theory-content fallback when runtime DB was not populated.

findings.summary: Formula-to-Simulation browser sequence used an invalid overlay-close assumption in the acceptance test.
findings.resolution: Aligned browser test with the real UI ownership and public interaction contract.

findings.summary: Math Lab close step in the browser test assumed a nonexistent public closeLab API and left the overlay blocking Professor Drill.
findings.resolution: Changed the test to close the Lab through the actual visible close control and wait for the overlay to clear.

findings.summary: Professor Drill had zero questions for L06 because companion content vaults were empty and the accepted Pass10 assessment source was not consumed.
findings.resolution: Added accepted theory-assessment Professor Q&A as a read-only source; no generated questions and no academic writes.

findings.summary: Study Command Center still preferred legacy E169 state during final hardening.
findings.resolution: Changed current lesson/activity resolution and canonical selection to E186-first while retaining legacy mirrors.

findings.summary: Final browser cache keys needed refresh after the hardening changes.
findings.resolution: Bumped relevant Math runtime cache query values before final acceptance run.

findings.summary: The unchanged ChatGPT Site static root would fail closed because no verified live Bauman Control Service deployment exists.
findings.resolution: Added an exact build-only owner-private Sites access boundary while preserving Device Gate v4 for Cloudflare, then passed source/package/browser/CI revalidation.

findings.summary: The first exact-SHA local package retry hit Python HTTP server connection refusals under parallel asset load.
findings.resolution: Used the repository Node server with a project-confined build root; the exact-SHA package rerun passed with zero request errors.

decision.note: Publish only this verified system lineage, then perform live post-publication revalidation before claiming W4 complete.
